title: Line Chart
content: Create line chart component for time-series data visualization. Container: responsive width, fixed or aspect-ratio height. Chart elements: SVG-based or canvas with chart library. Lines: smooth curves, multiple series with different colors. Axes: X-axis with time labels, Y-axis with value scale and grid lines. Tooltip: show values on hover with date. Legend: series names with color indicators. Time range selector: buttons for 7D, 30D, 90D, 1Y. Loading state: skeleton placeholder.

variants.simple: Create line chart showing data trends over time with hover tooltips.

variants.advanced: Create line chart component for time-series data visualization using Recharts, Chart.js, or custom SVG. Container: responsive width (w-full), aspect-ratio height (aspect-[16/9] or fixed h-80), bg-white rounded-lg p-4. Chart elements: SVG-based with ResponsiveContainer wrapper. Lines: smooth curves (type="monotone") or straight segments, multiple series support (up to 5) with distinct colors from accessible palette. Stroke width 2-3px, optional area fill with gradient (linearGradient from color to transparent). Axes: X-axis with time labels (formatted dates: "Jan 1", "Mon", etc.), Y-axis with value scale, grid lines (stroke-dasharray="3 3" in light gray), axis labels and tick marks. Data points: optional dots on line (r={4}), larger dots highlighted on hover (r={6}). Tooltip: custom tooltip component appearing on hover, shows date and all series values with color indicators, semi-transparent background with shadow. Legend: below chart, horizontal layout, series names with color circles, click to toggle series visibility (strike-through when hidden). Interactions: hover for tooltip, optional zoom/pan for large datasets using brush component. Responsive: reduce point density (show every Nth point) on smaller screens, simplify axis labels. Time range selector: button group (7D, 30D, 90D, 1Y, Custom), active state highlighted, triggers data refetch. Annotations: optional reference lines for targets/thresholds. Loading state: skeleton chart placeholder matching dimensions. Empty state: "No data available" message with illustration. Animation: lines draw in on initial load. Accessibility: provide data table alternative, proper ARIA labels. Dark mode: adjust colors for dark background.
